name: Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips or clasped in front of your chest.
Step one foot back and diagonally behind your standing leg, landing on the ball of that foot.
Bend both knees to lower your hips until your front thigh approaches parallel to the floor.
Push through your front foot to return to standing and alternate sides.
tips: Keep your front knee pointing in the same direction as your toes.
Keep your torso upright and hips facing mostly forward throughout the step.
